decisionScope: Only a five-case synthetic engineering pilot with the explicitly stated paired denominator; not clinical validation or a generalizable efficacy claim.

study.revisionsAfterFrozenRun: Evaluation artifacts and documentation only; no runtime source changes.

denominatorPolicy: All final planned tasks in the selected run stay in the completion denominator. Failed/cancelled tasks are incomplete; partial assistant text is ignored. Retry attempts are reported separately and never create extra planned tasks. A hidden historical fact is excluded unless a prior/current actual patient disclosure is recorded.

disclosedHistoryReference.provenanceLimitation: These frozen run rows contain aggregate AMA call/token counters but no per-fact recalledFacts/sourceId records. Historical correctness is scored only against synthetic facts explicitly disclosed in the actual same-arm patient exchanges; it does not prove an AMA source hit.

supportValidity.reason: No independent claim-to-passage adjudication is available; full passage text is not included in the blinded engineering score packet.

latencyMs.method: linear interpolation over all final task latencies, including failed runs/timeouts

single.note: Observed token counts only; missing failed-run usage is not imputed, and no monetary cost is reported.

integrated.note: Observed token counts only; missing failed-run usage is not imputed, and no monetary cost is reported.

observedTokens.method: reported observed token counts, no currency conversion; failed runs without usage remain unmeasured

separatePriorRunReference.comparisonPolicy: Separate source version; do not pool or make a causal cross-version claim.
